why: eForms CAN 25504477 (the only notice). 9 distinct lots, one award and one contract each. S EUR 4,521,000.00 equals the notice's BT-118 to the cent (S/T 0.00 %). The head without W is null (BT-709/BT-118 are never elected), so S replaces no figure. Note for the skeptic, no verdict impact: lots 7-9 are '(recettes)' resale lots; the buyer's BT-118 includes them, and no rubric class applies.

Two territorial lots (distinct CIGs), each a single-operator framework awarded once at its base amount in F06 21256163 (689,108 + 389,377). S EUR 1,078,485 equals CN F05 20349868's VAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL exactly; the estimate vouch comes from a 2-section CN with both lots in S. The sum of per-lot ceilings is not not_additive (read18 note 5). The head without W is lot 1 alone (63.9 %).

eForms CAN 25517196, 7 trades with 7 winners and 7 contracts. The BT-720 values sum exactly to BT-118 EUR 4,477,729.39. The BT-709 copies the whole total onto every lot (7x would be EUR 31.3 m), but S does not sum it, so there is no double count. The head without W is null.

F03 21978620 awards lot 1 HUF 58,136,250 and lot 2 HUF 61,308,225, with procedure VAL_TOTAL HUF 119,444,475 = S exactly. F20 22266151 swaps in equivalent products on lot 2 with VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE = AFTER 61,308,225, so S takes lot 2 once and there is no pre/post mix. Both sides are net without options. The head without W is lot 2 alone (51.3 %).

Partial sum, the read18 7398935 shape. F03 22628724 awards lot 1 191,280.95 and lot 3 74,798.00 (lot 2 unsuccessful), with VAL_TOTAL 266,078.95 = S exactly. Lot 2's re-award (22628772, EUR 73,188.24) sits on a lot-null row and is not summed. S is 78.4 % of the full EUR 339,267.19 against the head's 21.6 %. It is not a double count. Fragile against a single-section placement drain (R10 would refuse), and it is not on the partial-sum pin list.

BGN 200,000 = 170,000 + 30,000. The two lots are different products with different contractors and contracts. Each lot's award equals its own estimate: the contracts run until the forecast value is reached, so each figure is that lot's own ceiling and no envelope is shared. S equals CN 23214436's VAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL; the CN has 2 Lot sections and both are summed, so no estimate-twin flag. The head without W is lot 2 alone (15 %).

21 distinct packages, each awarded once. The first CAN, 24561226, holds 20 lots summing to PLN 563,765.36, but its BT-161 of 785,837.16 already includes lot 18. Lot 18 (222,071.80, contract signed 2025-01-20 before that CAN was dispatched) was published later in CAN 24758276, whose BT-161 covers only its own lot. So the vouch is genuine and was not superseded. The two diaper lots serve different units, with separate contracts and values. The head without W is lot 18 alone (28 %).

Two single-supplier framework lots (denim jackets and trousers; denim shorts), each with its own ceiling, summed at the original awards. HUF 459,995,328 equals CAN 20808119's procedure VAL_TOTAL and CN 20595292's estimate total. The 2022 F20 value increases are modification kinds and are not used, so pre- and post-modification values are not mixed. The CN's lot-1 VAL_OBJECT has a digit transposition, with no effect. The head without W is lot 1 alone (79.5 %).

Construction works in 20 different towns, awarded by CAN 21475284 (6 more lots were discontinued and carry no value). HUF 1,381,739,164 equals that CAN's procedure VAL_TOTAL exactly (recomputed). Lots 4–7 come from F20 restatements of the original awards; the value increases on lots 4 and 7 are excluded. The head without W is lot 7 alone (4.7 %).

Ville de Paris: three separate single-operator frameworks, three contractors. Each lot's award (4.5m / 4.0m / 1.8m) is that lot's 48-month maximum. S of EUR 10.3m equals CAN 19055486's stated procedure maximum (TED-HIGH; LOW 3.5m is the sum of the lot minima). The maxima belong to different lots, so they add up. S sits on the stated range's top, so it is not farther than the head. The head is lot 1 alone (43.7 %).

Three regional sludge lots, each a single-operator framework, and S = F06 21404947 procedure VAL_TOTAL HUF 476,573,000 to the forint. LOT-3 is taken once, from the F20 restating the 274,075,000 award; that F20 raises lot 3 to 301,481,938 (VAL_TOTAL_AFTER). Head = lot 3 alone (57.5 % of S). Against the post-modification total 503,979,938, S is -5.4 % and the head -45.6 %.

Seven macro-lots, seven winners. S = 7,267,960.13 matches the CAN's VAL_TOTAL 7,267,960.00 (the CAN drops 13 cents). LOT-3 is taken once, from F20 avenant 3, at its original 1,022,664.09; the avenant raises lot 3 to 1,435,222.03 (VAL_TOTAL_AFTER). Head = lot 3 alone (14.1 %). Against the post-modification total, S is -5.4 % and the head -86.7 %.

Three furniture lots awarded by three separate CANs (two winners). S = CN 22059514 VAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL 164,676.75 to the cent. The vouch is estimate kind from a three-section CN whose lots are all summed, so the estimate-twin flag does not apply. Each award equals its lot budget (noted for the skeptic, same shape as read_a_2's 7763513). Head = lot 2 alone (16.0 %).

Roznava insurance in 3 parts (keys LOT-0001/0003/0004; no LOT-0002 section exists), each with one winner and its own contract. S = CAN BT-1118 EUR 290,383 = sum of BT-660 = sum of BT-720. Live head is null, so S cannot be farther.

NEAK buys four distinct factor VIII / VWF products, each under a single-operator framework (Kbt. 105(1)(a)) with its own contract. Values are net for the full framework quantity. S = CAN BT-1118 HUF 15,060,500,000 to the forint (read18 note 5). Live head is null.

Magyar Posta insurance 2019. F03 20765679 awards 5 distinct insurance lines (5 contracts, 4 insurers). Procedure VAL_TOTAL HUF 464,332,787 equals S exactly. Two single-lot F20s restate lots 1 and 2 at their award values, so there is no pre/post-modification mix. The head without W is lot 1 alone (13.9 % of S). Note for the skeptic: every lot figure, the buyer's total and the head are all annual premiums, so the basis is the same throughout.

GSA/EUSPA security monitoring: 3 cascade framework lots, at most 2 contractors per lot. S counts each lot's ceiling once (12,621,400 + 5,082,000 + 7,986,000), not once per contractor, which would be 51.4 m (S1a not taken). S equals CN 20567519's VAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL of EUR 25,689,400 and also the buyer's award totals added (20,607,400 for lots 1+3 + 5,082,000 for lot 2). Estimate vouch from a 3-section CN whose lots are all in S. The head is lot 2 alone (19.8 %).

Port of Antwerp-Bruges grazing: eForms CAN 24751505 (subtype 30), 5 geographic clusters, one winner and one contract each. Per lot BT-720 = BT-709. BT-118 EUR 1,140,120 equals S exactly. The head without W is null (BT-709/BT-118 are never elected), so S replaces no figure and cannot be farther.

COBORU fertiliser: F03 23660402 awards 2 distinct product lots (2 contracts, 1 tender each). The procedure VALUE_RANGE LOW = HIGH = PLN 337,651.20 equals S. The Range vouch is from a notice naming both summed keys, so G-cover keeps it. Prices are plausible, so no slip. The head is lot 1 (87.3 % of S).

Le Havre AMO for the Harfleur recycling centre: F03 20835362 awards lots 1, 3 and 4. Lot 2 is PROCUREMENT_UNSUCCESSFUL and never awarded, so this is not a partial sum. Procedure VAL_TOTAL EUR 116,530 equals S exactly, and lot 4's optional tranche is included on both sides. The 2022 F20 restates lot 1 at 9,980 on a lot-null row that S does not sum. The head is lot 1 (8.6 % of S).

eForms CAN 24822363 awards 3 distinct product lots (bread, viennoiserie, pastry), each to one winner with its own contract (fa-wo-rc). S = EUR 334,400.49 = sum of the BT-720 winning tenders, +0.56% from the BT-118 EUR 332,553.00 (= sum of the per-lot BT-709 maxima, the G-filtered vouch from a notice naming all 3 keys). The live head is null, so S cannot be farther; read18 note 5 applies. Skeptic note: the values may be annual (the lot text says inventories are for 1 year).

F06 22708527 awards 7 distinct LOT_NO 1-7 work packages (3 contractors, none a group). S = EUR 4,442,428.69 = the procedure VAL_TOTAL to the cent, and also VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE in all seven F20s. The F20 increases (lots 1, 2, 3) are modification kinds, excluded under the 7380025 convention; their LotResults restate the original awards on lot-null rows. The head is lot 1 only (EUR 473,967.30, 10.7% of S).

Two distinct lots (general fleet; Soviet- and Russian-made vehicles), contracts 39 and 40 with one operator each. S = BGN 342,000 = CN VAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL (the vouch, a 2-section CN with both lots in S) = F03 VAL_TOTAL. The F20s only extend the term (BEFORE = AFTER) and restate each lot at its award. The per-lot net financial ceilings are additive (read18 note 5). The head is lot 1 only (BGN 218,000, 63.7%).

F03 22173860 awards 5 of 6 building lots (lot 4 Posta unsuccessful, only invalid tenders; lot 3 a joint-tender consortium, one award). S = HUF 1,630,930,456 = the procedure VAL_TOTAL to the forint. The summed F20 rows restate the original awards; the lot 1 and lot 5 increases are modification values and are excluded. The head is lot 2 only (21.5%). Counting the modifications, S would be 95% of the post-modification total against 20.5% for the head.

eForms CAN 24991969 awards 3 distinct territorial cleaning lots (Strasbourg; 67/68 outside Strasbourg; 57), one winner and one contract each (fa-wo-rc, BT-720 = BT-709). S = EUR 1,069,830.00 = BT-118 exactly, vouched by the notice naming all 3 keys. The live head is null (BT-709 is partner-only and BT-118 is never elected), so S cannot be farther; read18 note 5 applies.

Renfe Viajeros diesel supply, 3 regional lots (Madrid+Andalucía / North / Mediterranean). CN F05 23230099 gives lot VAL_OBJECTs 1,787,724.86 / 1,334,225.46 / 2,728,018.38 and VAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL EUR 5,849,968.70. F06 23558847 awards each lot once (Pentagas; UTE Esergui-Disteser x2; contracts 4500075098/097/095) at VAL_TOTAL = estimate. S = 5,849,968.70 equals the buyer's procedure estimate to the cent. The vouch is estimate kind from a 3-section CN whose lots are all in S. Per-lot single-supplier maxima, so read18 note 5 applies. Head = lot 3 (46.6% of S). Note: the F04 PIN 23185304 (same ref 2023-00675, same lots) stated EUR 21,555,456 and is stored as a separate tender, 7711779. It is a forecast. The CN and CAN agree on 5.85 m, and S would still be nearer than the head even if 21.6 m were the true value.

Elektrorazpredelenie Sever, LV cable fittings, 4 lots. CN 20963427 gives lot VAL_OBJECTs BGN 1,550,000 / 715,000 / 107,000 / 285,000. F06 21360130 awards LOT_NO 1-4 (contracts 59-1..59-4; VAK-02 lots 1-2, Tilkom lots 3-4) at VAL_TOTAL = estimate, with procedure VAL_TOTAL BGN 2,657,000 = S. The 2023 F20 23241877 changes lot 1's unit prices with value unchanged (BEFORE = AFTER 1,550,000), and S takes lot 1 once at that value. Distinct lots, one supplier each, no double count, no pre/post mix. Head = lot 1 (58.3% of S).

CM Zelazna, ultrasound scanners, 2 lots (1 scanner / 2 scanners). F03 21615726 awards LOT_NO 1 PLN 769,000 and LOT_NO 2 PLN 138,500 to Intimex, 1 tender each. The procedure VAL_RANGE_TOTAL is LOW = HIGH = PLN 907,500 (PROCUREMENT_TOTAL), equal to S. The range vouch names both summed keys, so G-cover keeps it. I checked the 11x unit-price gap for a x10 slip on lot 2: the buyer's own total uses 138,500 (a x10 lot 2 would make it 2,154,000), and no CN figure contradicts either lot. Head = lot 1 (84.7% of S).

Tarn Habitat, single-supplier frameworks (fa-wo-rc, mono-attributaire) for 3 trades. CAN 24887461 awards LOT-0001 SIDER 959,000, LOT-0002 RICHARDSON 364,000 and LOT-0003 FOUSSIER 700,000 (BT-720, separate contracts 2025a0010-01/02/03). BT-118 = EUR 2,023,000 = S. Each result also carries a copied BT-709 of 2,023,000 (285956 shape). S sums BT-720, not the copy, so there is no double count. Per-lot maxima sum to the buyer's own total (read18 note 5). Head is null, so S cannot be farther.

RTK for Terviseamet, COVID-19 services, 2 lots. F21 20974563 awards LOT_NO 1 (sampling) to Medicum at EUR 576,200 and LOT_NO 2 (lab testing) to Synlab at EUR 1,584,000, with procedure VAL_TOTAL EUR 2,160,200 = S. The results print LOT_NO 2 then 1, and the store keys them correctly. Two F20s (21012872 lot 2 +tests, 21005314 lot 1 +team) restate each lot's original award in their LotResults and give VAL_TOTAL_BEFORE 2,160,200 / AFTER 2,425,760. AFTER is a modification kind and is not summed, so there is no pre/post mix. This is not the 5816379 shape, since there is no re-award. S is -10.9% vs the post-modification total and the head (lot 1, 26.7% of S) is -76.2%. Precedent: 7380025 and the M2-fallback modification caveat.
